marta.s: Heads up — bringing up hf->redwood conversion for openchat-small2 on quantized A100. Streaming responses sometimes cut off mid-sentence.
ryan.k: Repro? logs?
marta.s: Short repro: request with chat template that appends '' sentinel twice. Tokenizer is byte-level; HF tokenizer returns two consecutive eos tokens (50256 50256). Runtime sees first and flushes.
marta.s: Minimal payload: ```json
{
  "model": "openchat-small2",
  "input": "tell me a short story",
  "stop": [""],
  "chat_template": "<|system|>You are a helpful assistant<|end|><|end|>"
}
```
ci-bot: deploy succeeded on test-gpu-3 (job 412) :white_check_mark:
li.z: hmm we changed legacy `eos_token` mapping in config.json during conversion — maybe we wrote `eos_token` as a list of strings instead of an int
marta.s: Exactly — config.json had "eos_token": [""], HF tokenizer uses a single int id; our loader accepted list and treated it as multi-token sentinel.
kevin: Suggestion: enforce strict typing on model manifest. Also add a streaming guard: require 2 consecutive eos tokens within a short window before cutting the stream to avoid false positives from tokenization quirks.
ryan.k: Alternatively collapse consecutive identical eos tokens before the streaming stop decision. That way multi-token sentinels won't trigger early.
li.z: I'll add a guard in the conversion script: if tokenizer outputs consecutive eos ids, collapse them and emit a warning. Also log raw token_ids for failing requests to make triage easier.
marta.s: Test plan: run quantized model with the chat template that contains double-sentinel, flood with 1k requests, and measure early-cutoff rate. Add an integration test in the hf-conversion pipeline that asserts no single-token premature stops.
kevin: Also update docs: clarify that `eos_token` in config.json should be an integer `eos_token_id` for byte-level tokenizers, and deprecate string-list form.
ci-bot: queued nightly bench job #482 on dedicated-quant (ETA ~40m) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
li.z: I'll open a PR with the conversion strict-typing + unit tests and paste link here when ready.
marta.s: thanks — keep the repro in the PR description (one-liner + raw token ids).
ryan.k: ack, will follow up if the bench shows regressions.
